Forecasting fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion; forecasting fourth-quarter EPS attributable to Intel of $0.10 and non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel of $0.25. SANTA CLARA, Calif., October 29, 2026 – Intel Corporation today reported third-quarter 2026 financial results. “Our Q3 results demonstrate improving execution, meaningful progress expanding supply and continued advancement of our process technology,” said Lip-Bu Tan, Intel CEO. “Despite near-term headwinds across the PC industry, demand for our CPUs remains robust, reinforcing our confidence in the long-term growth opportunities for our business. Our immediate priority is to unlock additional supply to meet extraordinary demand for our Xeon family, while strengthening our product portfolio and roadmap. We are moving with urgency and focus to capitalize on these opportunities to deliver sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value.” “We delivered another solid quarter. Revenue, gross margin and earnings per share exceeded guidance, including our strongest data center revenue growth in 15 years,” said David Zinsner, Intel CFO. “Looking ahead, we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year, but we remain optimistic about the opportunities across our broader portfolio, and we will continue making disciplined investments in capacity and working capital to increase supply and support future growth.” Q3 2026 Financial Results GAAP Non-GAAP Q3 2026 Q3 2025 vs. Q3 2025 Q3 2026 Q3 2025 vs. Q3 2025 Revenue ($B) $16.5 $13.7 up 21% Gross margin 43.0% 38.2% up 4.8 ppts 44.1% 40.0% up 4.1 ppts R&D and MG&A ($B) $4.5 $4.4 up 4% $4.1 $3.9 up 3% Operating margin 15.3% 5.0% up 10.3 ppts 19.6% 11.2% up 8.4 ppts Tax rate 11.6% 6.6% up 5 ppts 11.0% 12.0% down 1 ppt Net in
